College of Lore.description: Bards who gather knowledge from everywhere, wielding secrets as weapons and shields.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.tldr: Gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.tldr: Use your Bardic Inspiration to subtract from an opponent's roll, attack, or damage.

6.name: Additional Magical Secrets
6.tldr: Learn two spells of your choice from any class, counting as bard spells for you.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.tldr: Use Bardic Inspiration to add to ability checks when you fail or to protect against weapon attacks.

College of Valor.description: Bards of the heroic tradition, supporting front-line combatants with inspiring martial prowess.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

3.name: Combat Inspiration
3.tldr: Allow allies to use Bardic Inspiration dice for weapon damage or armor class boosts.

6.name: Extra Attack
6.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

14.name: Battle Magic
14.tldr: When you use your action to cast a bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
